title: Component functions and resonance
blurb: Say what rectifiers, relays, regulators, transformers, meters and ICs do, and what makes a circuit resonant.

T6D01.why: A **rectifier** (diodes) passes current in one direction only, turning AC into varying DC.
T6D01.trap: A transformer changes AC voltage but leaves it AC.

T6D02.why: A **relay** uses a coil's magnetic pull to work a switch: an electrically-controlled switch.
T6D02.trap: Amplifiers and pass transistors are not switches moved by a coil.

T6D03.why: A shield **prevents unwanted signals coupling** into or out of the wire.
T6D03.trap: Shielding adds no current capacity and does not lower resistance.

T6D04.why: A **meter** displays a quantity such as volts or amps as a number.
T6D04.trap: A potentiometer adjusts; it does not display.

T6D05.why: A **regulator** holds the power supply's output voltage steady.
T6D05.trap: A filter smooths ripple but does not set the voltage.

T6D06.why: A **transformer** steps 120 V AC down to a lower AC voltage.
T6D06.trap: A diode only rectifies; it doesn't change the AC voltage.

T6D07.why: An **LED** is the common indicator light. A FET and a Zener diode have other jobs, so only the LED qualifies.

T6D08.why: An inductor plus a **capacitor** forms a resonant circuit.
T6D08.trap: A resistor or Zener diode does not give the energy swing of resonance.

T6D09.why: An **integrated circuit** puts many semiconductors and other parts in one package.
T6D09.trap: A transformer is windings; a transducer converts energy types.

T6D10.why: Component 2 is a transistor. A small base current **controls the flow of a larger current**.
T6D10.trap: Lamps give off light and batteries supply energy; the transistor controls current.

T6D11.why: An **inductor and capacitor**, in series or parallel, make a tuned circuit.
T6D11.trap: A regulator or resistor network does not resonate.
